column1: # Scope: selection and query schedule ONLY. VMap responses are ordered authored scripts, NOT geometry.
# Fixed useVmaps=true, isHeightCalcEnabled=true; GetGrid returns source flat-height dispatch or nullptr.
# No liquid, map loading/coordinates, real VMap ray traversal, support, or movement claim.
# All *_bits are hexadecimal binary32; case/map_present/call_count are decimal. Unused calls are +0,+0.
# Scripts contain four replies; only call_count entries are consumed. Other replies intentionally remain unused.
# Selector-only vectors include negative ranges, sentinel heights and unclamped ranges beyond public query bounds.
# Map absence supplies source VMAP_INVALID_HEIGHT_VALUE; provided map_height_bits is ignored when map_present=0.
